name: omni-desktop
description: A local-first desktop tool for managing developer context.

scripts.check:size: bash scripts/check-line-counts.sh && find src tests -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec sh -c 'for file do lines=$(wc -l < "$file"); if [ "$lines" -gt 500 ]; then printf "FAIL: %s has %s physical lines;\n" "$file" "$lines"; exit 1; fi; done' sh {} +
